runs.result: Initial .venv interpreter lacked websockets; failed before network. Existing .venv-upgrade used for subsequent runs. No dependencies installed.

2643 completed deliveries; 13 eligible books; 9 allMids references; 4 perpetual contexts; 9 eligible same-USDT reference basis rows; 3 missing USD/USDT FX rows. Five real native spot context streams failed on activeSpotAssetCtx and reached circuit_open. All registry leases closed; no pending asyncio tasks.

2713 completed deliveries over 45 seconds of collection; 13 eligible books, 9 allMids references, 9 contexts (4 perps plus 5 native spot products), 9 eligible same-USDT reference basis rows and 3 unavailable USD/USDT basis rows. All nine context streams live at snapshot. Zero callback/acquisition errors; default production collector lock respected; zero remaining subscriptions or pending asyncio tasks after cleanup.

observed_adapter_defect.before: Decoder required subscription type as data channel for all products, rejecting actual spot responses.
observed_adapter_defect.fix: Choose the expected data discriminator by context product type; preserve subscription/ack handling and reject cross-product channel mismatches.
observed_adapter_defect.parent_demo_requirement: Synthetic spot context data must use activeSpotAssetCtx, while spot subscription/ack type remains activeAssetCtx.

financial_semantics.basis: Binance USDT spot midpoint versus actual Hyperliquid mark/oracle/mid; non-executable reference analysis, never arbitrage or synthesized bid/ask.
financial_semantics.missing_fx: With no explicit FX rates, genuine Coinbase BTC-USD versus Hyperliquid BTC-USDT returned missing_fx:USDT:USD and missing_fx:USD:USDT with both derived basis values null.
financial_semantics.funding: Actual public funding-rate values retained; adapter attaches its existing 3600000000000 ns hourly interval. No annualization or funding-payment verification performed.
financial_semantics.open_interest: Actual raw OI values retained as adapter-declared base units with adapter_declared_not_independently_verified provenance. No USD conversion or independent primary field-unit confirmation.
financial_semantics.identity: Native token IDs, contract addresses and native-USDC/native-USDT0 quotes preserved. HYPE native spot/perpetual basis remained incompatible_underlying_identity; no ticker-based fungibility or USDC/USDT equivalence invented.
